text: Module 2, Unit 2, Cute Animals, Period 4, and 4.5Hello children, nice to see you.Today we are going to learnModule 2, Unit 2, Cute Animals, Period 4, and 4.5Animal FriendsFirst, let's learn the song.Oe, OJo, ToeOe, OGoat, Toast, Boat, CoatO, OFlo, Hello, GoLet's read the rhyme with the recording.Ready?Good!Today we are going to learn more sentences.Please read it after the recording.Good job!Let's read it again.Excellent!Danny makes an information cardof his favorite animal.Kitty and Danny are talking about it.Please read the dialogue with the recording.How old is he?He is five years old.What color is your pet?He is green.What does he like eating?He likes eating meat.What doesn't he like eating?He doesn't like eating fruit at all.Kitty is going to introduce Danny's favorite animal.Can you be Kitty?Danny likes tortoises.He has a pet.His name is Nono.His favorite food is meat.I'd like to show you one of my student's homework.Look, she drew a picture and completed the card first.Then she asked and answered with her friend.At last, she wrote an introduction of her friend's favorite animal.I think you also did a great job.Look at this information card.Try to say something about this cat.Please read it with me.Ming is a cat.She is two years old.She is white.Her favorite food is fish.Ming is very cute.Today, we are going to learn a story about Ming.Let's go!First, watch a video.After watching, answer the question.What does Ming want?Ming and MogWhat do you have, Mog?I have a fish.Do you want the fish, Ming?Yes, it smells nice.I like it.Great!She wants the fish.Why does she want the fish?Because it smells nice.Read after me.Ming wants the fish.It smells nice.Now, let's read in verbs.First, you are Ming.Now, you are Mog.What do you have, Mog?Ming's favorite food is fish.Whose fish is it?Oh, it's Mog's fish.What do Ming and Mog do at last?Let's go on watching.Let's eat it together.Thank you, Mog.They eat together.Let's read in verbs.Please read the story by yourself first.Now, let's read it with the recording.In this story, Ming and Mog share their food with each other.They are happy.They are friends.Look!Who's coming?Mini and Ella are coming.Do you want to know more about them?What does Mili like eating?She likes eating apples.What does Ella like eating?She likes eating leaves.Now, it's your turn.Say something about Mili and Ella.Please read with me.Mili is a mouse.She is small.Ella is an elephant.She is big.Today we are going to learn a story about Mili and Ella.Mili likes eating apples.One day,Mili sees an apple on the tree.She wants to eat it.But look!Mili is small and short.But the tree is tall.Please read it with the recording.Mili wants to eat the apple.Listen!Who can help her?Hi, Ella!I want to eat the apple.Can you help me?Yes, let me help you.Oh, Ella can help Mili.How does Ella help Mili?Can you guess?Now, watch a video, please.She shakes the tree.The apple falls down.Some leaves fall down too.Look at this word.Shake.Spell the word with me.Ella shakes the tree.An apple falls down.Read at me.Falls down.Let's read a chant.One apple falls down.Ella shakes the tree again.What falls down too?Oh, some leaves.It's your turn.Read the chant by yourself.Let's read the chant with the recording.Some leaves fall down.Ella comes.How does she help Mili?Please read and complete the sentences.Ella helps Mili.What do they do at last?Please listen.Thank you, Ella.I like eating apples.Yummy, yummy!I like eating leaves.What do they do?Mili eats the apple.She likes it.Ella eats the leaves.Let's watch the whole story again.Mili and EllaMili sees an apple on the tree.She wants to eat it,but the tree is tall.Read this story by yourself.Now please read it with the recording.Ella eats the apple.And the rest is a little different.Ella and EllaElla eats the apple.In the first story,Me and Mark share their food with each other.In the second story,Ella helps Millie.I hope you like these two stories.So much for today.Today's homework.One, look and read page 24 of student's book.Two, look and read page 26 of student's book.Class is over.Goodbye, children.See you next time.
